responsibility: Declares the Rust AST classes for type syntax and type-parameter bounds. It models trait bounds, `impl Trait`, trait objects, parenthesized, tuple, never, pointer, reference, array, slice, inferred, and bare-function types, as well as helper structures like maybe-named function parameters and bound lifetimes, with cloning, visitor hooks, and source locations; this file is the Rust frontend’s main AST representation for parsed type forms and bound lists.
